title.zh-CN: 服止痛药后上腹痛伴呕吐 · 43岁女性

summary.zh-CN: 围绕服止痛药后上腹痛伴呕吐，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。

text.zh-CN: 停塞来昔布并接受多项支持治疗后，13 天腹痛腹胀消失，胰酶降至正常范围、CT 改善，出院。历史多药方案不作为今天照抄的处方。
text.en: After withdrawal and multiple supportive therapies, pain/distension resolved over thirteen days, enzymes normalised and CT improved. The historical multi-drug regimen is not a prescription to copy.

feedback.zh-CN: 当前原则不要求无差别长期禁食或预防性抗菌。
feedback.en: Current principles do not require indiscriminate prolonged fasting or prophylactic antibiotics.

feedback.zh-CN: 缺乏感染证据不能自动如此处理。

feedback.zh-CN: 不应以再次诱发伤害来求证。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 急性胰腺炎与塞来昔布暴露有时间关联，病因归属仍为临床判断。
conclusion.en: Acute pancreatitis was temporally associated with celecoxib exposure, with causality remaining a clinical assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 诊断胰腺炎与确定病因是两步。
keyReasoning.en: Diagnosing pancreatitis and establishing cause are separate.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: NICE NG104 不建议预防性抗菌或无理由禁食。
keyReasoning.en: NICE NG104 advises against prophylactic antimicrobials and unnecessary fasting.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不以危险再激发替代因果评估。
keyReasoning.en: Do not replace causality assessment with dangerous rechallenge.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
